fields.DESCRIPTION: Chic and timeless, the Noir Bloom Handcrafted Sling Bag blends classic black-and-cream floral fabric with earthy jute texture. Finished with fringed detailing, brown faux leather straps, and golden accents, it brings rustic charm with a modern edge. Perfect for brunches, casual outings, or evening strolls, this versatile sling bag is designed to complement both ethnic and western styles effortlessly.
